meta.name: Our Sticky Love
meta.description: An ambitious prosecutor loses her memory and moves in with a boxing coach who claims to be her boyfriend. Can this sticky situation turn into real love?

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Go Eun-sae wakes up in the hospital with no recollection of who she is. Suddenly, scruffy-looking Jang Tae-ha shows up claiming to be her boyfriend.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: From quirky villagers to shady little details, everything feels off to Eun-sae — especially Tae-ha. Later, she tries to figure out if he can be trusted.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Tae-ha takes Eun-sae on a fun day out to cheer her up. However, news starts to get back to mafia boss Baek Sang-gil about what happened with Eun-sae.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Eun-sae heads to Seoul in search of answers, only to be confronted with the ugly truth about who she used to be — and the painful past of Tae-ha.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Eun-sae and Tae-ha's relationship grows sweeter, but some sticky encounters with Tae-ha's old friends put their newfound intimacy to the test.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Tiny misunderstandings snowball into wild rumors all over town. The village trio tries to fix it, only to worsen things — and Eun-sae corners Tae-ha.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: When Eun-sae vanishes, the village searches for her. Meanwhile, her doctor An Gi-jun turns up at Tae-ha's door at night with questions about her past.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Sang-gil finally realizes what Tae-ha has done. Realizing Eun-sae's safety is in danger, Tae-ha makes plans to help her escape.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: With her memories revived, Eun-sae buckles down on her plan to go after Sang-gil. But her very existence now puts the whole town in danger — Tae-ha included.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Eun-sae busies herself with putting Sang-gil away. But with Eun-sae held up at work, Tae-ha wonders if there's any space left for him in her life.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Tae-ha and Eun-sae reunite with everyone in the village, but things take a turn when Sang-gil shows up — only to discover a shocking truth.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Tae-ha confronts Sang-gil to save his grandmother. Despite Sang-gil's constant threats, will Tae-ha and Eun-sae stay happily stuck together forever?

meta.slogan: No past. No proof. He's my only clue!
